### Others

I want to fine-tune Llama3.2-11B-vision-instruct on my customized text dataset in 'identify.json' format. It encounters an error `ValueError: Invalid input type. Must be a single image, a list of images, or a list of batches of images.` when I send pure text without any image in chatbox. Although I loaded untrained raw Llama model for chat using 'mllama' template, this error still appears. Text-only chats only work with the 'llama3' template.

I find some similar issues #6635 #5918 #5958, but they don't work for me. Many thanks for your time and attention!

The issue involves the integration and behavior of an LLM-based agent system, specifically related to the handling of multimodal inputs (text vs. images) and the configuration of the LLM template (`mllama` vs. `llama3`). This aligns with the "Prompt-related issues" and "Model dependency issues" in the taxonomy.
